product_assumptions: Activity choices 1.4/1.6/1.8 are approximate product mappings, separate from Mifflin RMR.
Maintenance ±10% is an interface uncertainty illustration, not a confidence interval.
Gentle loss min(300 kcal,10% maintenance), ±5% target band, rounding to 10 kcal: product policy.
Female 1200/male 1500 lower-intake safeguard and BMI/age eligibility are product scope, not universal safe thresholds.
100/50 g TOTAL carbohydrate modes do not guarantee ketosis; no automatic polyol subtraction.
30 days/5% weight change prompts review only; no automatic calorie adaptation.
